g.text: File recovery — three states, two ways back
A snapshot is planned. Soft delete is a safety net with an expiry date.
the two mechanisms answer different questions
snapshot "give me the share as it was on Tuesday" you must take it in advance
soft delete "I deleted that by accident an hour ago" automatic, 14 day window
# a snapshot survives deletion of the file, soft delete does not survive
# deletion of the share itself - that is what a lock in Lab 1.3 is for
